fact: Every actor access declaration gets a LIST behaviour and listOf operation when generateBehaviours is set, with no list-permission check.
The rdbms schema CLI only prints a message when postgres dbUser or dbPassword is missing and keeps running with empty credentials.
The flutter-maven-plugin arguments parameter is set by the system property flutter.arguments, dot-separated.
The flutter-maven-plugin parallel parameter is set by the system property flutter.parallel, default false.
The featuredActions range checks on action groups are critiques (warnings), not blocking constraints.
enabledBy, hiddenBy and requiredBy conditions must name a root-type attribute and a boolean attribute; they are constraints.
Date.of takes named numeric arguments year, month and day, e.g. Date.of(year = 2022, month = 1, day = 1).
The CLI GraphQL schema maps Integer and Long attributes to GraphQL Int (Long narrowed to 32-bit), not String.
Transfer relation declarations accept no selector modifier; the grammar allows default, eager, required, enabled, choices, create, update and delete.
The JAX-RS address comes from the applicationPath entry of Application.getProperties(), not from the OSGi service property.
Jackson feature keys are JacksonProvider.SerializationFeature.<NAME> and DeserializationFeature.<NAME>, with no jaxrs.provider prefix.
